messages: It seems #p208#, the carpenter of #m10001000#, is looking for someone worthy of becoming his apprentice.

After I told #p208#, the carpenter of #m10001000#, that I wanted to become his apprentice, he gave me a test. He said that woodcrafting requires one to have the proper strength and knowledge and asked me to defeat monsters near #m10001000# and collect #b#t4000005#es#k.
I passed the test given by #p208#, the carpenter of #m10001000#. Does this mean I can now become a proper carpenter in Maple World?
name: Vicious in Need of an Apprentice
